attempted_claim: Fix cogenus delta in {11,12}. Let N^{d,delta}_{trop}(y) be the Block-Gottsche refined floor-diagram count for rational plane curves of degree d, let N^{d,delta}_{rel}(y) be the Gottzsche-Shende relative refined Severi degree, and let N^{d,delta}_{abs}(y) be the absolute refined Severi degree from Hilbert schemes of points on P^2. Decide whether the threshold d>=floor(delta/2)+1 suffices for all three Laurent polynomials to coincide and to equal a single universal polynomial in d with coefficients in Z[y^{+-1/2}]. A complete answer is either a proof of coincidence for all d at or above the threshold for both delta=11 and delta=12 with the explicit universal polynomials exhibited, or a rigorous witness triple (delta,d) with d at or above threshold plus explicit computations of at least two of the three invariants showing they differ as Laurent polynomials.
decisive_failure: The classical Caporaso-Harris engine was implemented and exactly validated, but no refined invariant (tropical, relative, or absolute) was computed because the refined recursion could not be validated locally and literature retrieval failed; the threshold coincidence question for delta 11 and 12 therefore remains fully open and none of the verification scripts establish any refined claim.
